christians-reading-classics.title: Alexis de Tocqueville - Democracy in America with John Wilsey (Replay)
christians-reading-classics.description: We’re revisiting one of the most famous outside views of America ever written. In the 1830s a young French aristocrat crossed the Atlantic, officially to study prisons, and was struck most by “the equality of conditions.” Church historian John Wilsey joins Nadya to discuss why Democracy in America is still a classic. They cover how Tocqueville saw religion thriving without a state church, how he traced American life back to the Puritans, and why he believed freedom depends on responsibility. John is professor of church history and philosophy at the Southern Baptist Theological Seminary. He also edited an abridged edition of Democracy in America .
